newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Horana share prices double.
newsitem.headline: Horana share prices double.

text.p: Share prices of Horana Plantations Ltd doubled to 20 rupees from 10 rupees in early Thursday trading, brokers said.
Brokers said the price jump was on small volume of about 100 shares and reflected demand by retail investors.
"Small retailers are going a bit wild on plantation shares, because tea is doing well," said a broker specialising in retailers.
Horana Plantations was one of six estate firms traded on the Colombo Stock Exchange after being privatised in 1995.
